answer: A bond is refunded only after 48 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The sparrow counter is kept in willow and karst exposes each reset. Someone therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 48 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2516 identities would post 3121 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
